items.title: Dual Focal Point Planning — outward (user) + inward (core spine) simultaneously
caq_questions: Which existing validated core element covers 80%+ of project-management planning?
What is the L1/L2/L3 breakdown for 'project management' in CSPS core spines?
How does the intake wizard enforce 'check existing validated element first'?
items.notes:
DONE S045 PROTO-036. Template live at tools/templates/dual-focal-plan.template.yaml. Registered in template-registry.md §1.
Governor directive S044. Vaulted per VAULT_DEFER protocol — process after active plans reach RZF.

CONCEPT: Every new capability/app gets planned with TWO focal points simultaneously:
  OUTWARD: user journeys, interface, tiers, permissions, specific use cases
  INWARD: which existing validated core element does this build on?
          L1 principle → L2 domain implementation → L3 specific delta

INVARIANT: Never recreate a validated core element. The system must MECHANICALLY
enforce checking what exists at planning time — not as a reminder, as a gate.
B_NO_INVENTION_WITHOUT_PRECEDENT_CHECK exists (T3-only). Needs T1+T2 upgrade.

TEMPLATE CONNECTION: apps/template/ + platform/templates/vault/ are the validated elements.
When planning new project management app: first gate = which template covers this?
Fork from template → only the delta is new. This is what makes the moat compound.

VAULT GATE NEEDED (PROTO-036): T1 hook that fires on new Governor input when
active plan exists → asks "is this urgent for active plan?" → if no → auto-registers
as unified-plan.yaml intake item → freezes until active plan reaches RZF.

PROCESSING ORDER: After S044 HANDOFF and S045 inheritance-registry.yaml are complete.

items.title: Turn count quality degradation notification — warn when tab exceeds quality threshold
items.notes:
Governor directive S044. Vaulted per VAULT_DEFER protocol.

CONCEPT: When a chat tab exceeds N turns (recommended: 40-50), auto-inject a
STRONG recommendation to move to a new tab, even if tokens remain.

WHY: Context quality degrades before token limit. Rules ratified at turn 1
are fuzzier by turn 40. The 25-turn refresh helps but doesn't fully prevent drift.

IMPLEMENTATION: Turn counter hook (user-prompt-submit-turn-counter.sh) already
counts turns. At turn 40: inject LEVEL-2 warning. At turn 60: inject LEVEL-3 STRONG
recommendation with handoff preparation checklist.

TRIGGER: If turn_count_this_session > 40 AND session not closing → inject:
"[QUALITY GATE: Turn 40+ detected. Context quality degrading.
 Strongly recommend: write HANDOFF + move to new tab.
 Quality matters more than token savings.]"

items.title: CSPS Architecture Quadrant — Foundation / Context / Prevention / Inheritance
items.notes: Four elements that appear in every significant CSPS architectural decision: (1) Foundation — what must exist first, (2) Context — who/what/why, (3) Prevention — what wrong thing is made impossible, (4) Inheritance — what is permanently carried forward. Every architectural decision must pass all four. Formalize as a checklist in creation-wizard-protocol.md and session-open.

items.title: Speech-to-Text Correction System — per-user vocabulary builder + system-wide distortion registry
items.notes: Two components: (1) per-user onboarding calibration session — user reads + corrects speech-to-text to build personal vocabulary map; (2) system-wide distortion registry — tracks common misrecognitions across all users. Feeds Threshold: correct before classify. Design: tools/vault/concepts/SPEECH-TO-TEXT-CORRECTION-SYSTEM.md. Moat: most AI systems ignore this gap.

items.title: Universal Behavior Hub — AI layer (AI/automation) + Human layer (Governor/devs/users)
items.notes: Universal core fields + two explicit sub-layers. AI/Automation layer: rule-based, instructable (AI Behavioral Profile + external AI profiles + automation entities). Human layer: psychological, emergent, observed (Governor + developers + external users: admins/semi-managers/team-leaders/end-users). Combinatorial Engine consumes from both. MUST keep layers explicitly separated — conflating AI cognition with human cognition is a design anti-pattern.

items.title: Private/Business Data Silo Architecture — encrypted separation of personal vs business logic
items.notes: Hard psychological and technical line: private personal data (family, relationships, health) stored in encrypted silo EXCLUDED from business-logic training sets. Prerequisites: consent model, encryption architecture, silo boundary validation. Must be designed BEFORE any CSPS app activates personal dimensions. Prevention priority: privacy architecture breach is worse than missing feature.

items.title: A/B/C/D Testing Hub — experimentation platform for user-facing flows with completion tracking
items.notes: Version management for user-facing flows (onboarding variants, etc.). User segmentation by percentage. Outcome tracking: completion rate, bail-out points, engagement depth. Auto-promote winner at statistical significance. Maps to activation_exit: evaluation-passed. Playground UI for experiment management. First use case: onboarding 3-question variants for APP-001.

items.title: Transparent Signing — AI-assisted outputs marked as such to protect user reputation
items.notes: Every AI-assisted outbound action (emails, reports, recommendations sent to external parties) is marked 'Assisted by AI' in a non-intrusive way. Protects user reputation while the engine is in activated (test drive) state. Allows engine to mature in live environment. Separate from Trust Ladder (which is about data collection) — this is about output labeling.

items.title: Bundle Advisor — PIE sub-engine for cross-app capability bundle suggestions
items.notes: PIE (R2.1) sub-engine that monitors capability usage across all CSPS apps and suggests bundle upgrades. Different from L3 Journey Orchestrator (which handles user journey paths) — this handles CAPABILITY bundles across app domains. Sources: CAIE cross-app patterns. Trigger: user profile in APP-001 shows signals → suggests REPORTING_BUNDLE activation. CSPS translation of DOC-001 Template Agent concept.

items.title: Combinatorial Engine — multi-dimensional reasoning with Dependency Matrix + Sensitivity Ladder
items.notes: Core engine for multi-dimensional user context with Dependency Strength grading (Isolated→Linked→Dependent→Synergetic). Three collection modes. Sensitivity Ladder (Tone/Depth/Urgency 1-4). Forward reasoning on trajectories. Vault design: tools/vault/concepts/COMBINATORIAL-ENGINE-RAW.md + tools/vault/processing/COMBINATORIAL-ENGINE-S123-ANALYSIS.md. Prerequisite: BEHAVIOR-HUB + PRIVATE-BUSINESS-SILOS + STT-CORRECTION-SYSTEM.
